insert data
```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)
individual_phenometrics_data <- read_csv("~/phenology-urban/data/raw/CONUS/NPN_Meng/individual_phenometrics_data.csv")
individual_leaf_bud <- subset(individual_phenometrics_data, Phenophase_Description == "Breaking leaf buds")
individual_color_leaf <- subset(individual_phenometrics_data, Phenophase_Description == "Colored leaves")
```

average with sites/species/year (avg.individual)
```{r}
individual_leaf_bud_filter <- individual_leaf_bud %>%
  group_by(Individual_ID, First_Yes_Year) %>%
  summarise(First_Yes_DOY = min(First_Yes_DOY, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  left_join(individual_leaf_bud, by = c("Individual_ID", "First_Yes_Year", "First_Yes_DOY"))%>%
  filter(First_Yes_DOY <= 183)

individual_color_leaf_filter <- individual_color_leaf %>%
  group_by(Individual_ID, First_Yes_Year) %>%
  summarise(First_Yes_DOY = min(First_Yes_DOY, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  left_join(individual_color_leaf, by = c("Individual_ID", "First_Yes_Year", "First_Yes_DOY")) %>%
  filter(First_Yes_DOY >= 182)

# breaking leaf buds (species) >= 80
individual_leaf_bud_filter2 <- individual_leaf_bud_filter %>%
    group_by(Genus, Species) %>%
    count() %>%
    filter(n >= 80) %>%
    inner_join(individual_leaf_bud_filter, by = c("Genus", "Species"))

# colored leaves (species) >= 40
individual_color_leaf_filter2 <- individual_color_leaf_filter %>%
    group_by(Genus, Species) %>%
    count() %>%
    filter(n >= 40) %>%
    inner_join(individual_color_leaf_filter, by = c("Genus", "Species"))

# species-site-year average doy for leaf-bud
species_leaf_bud <- individual_leaf_bud_filter2 %>%
  group_by(Site_ID, Latitude, Longitude, 
           Genus, Species, First_Yes_Year, 
           Tmin_Winter, Tmin_Spring, Tmin_Summer, Tmin_Fall, 
           Tmax_Winter, Tmax_Spring, Tmax_Summer, Tmax_Fall) %>%
  summarise(First_Yes_DOY = mean(First_Yes_DOY, na.rm = TRUE))

# species-site-year average doy for color_leaf
species_color_leaf <- individual_color_leaf_filter2 %>%
  group_by(Site_ID, Latitude, Longitude, 
           Genus, Species, First_Yes_Year, 
           Tmin_Winter, Tmin_Spring, Tmin_Summer, Tmin_Fall, 
           Tmax_Winter, Tmax_Spring, Tmax_Summer, Tmax_Fall) %>%
  summarise(First_Yes_DOY = mean(First_Yes_DOY, na.rm = TRUE))
```

extract ALAN
```{r}
library(sf)
library(sp)
library(raster)
library(stringr)

coordinates(species_leaf_bud) <- c("Longitude", "Latitude")
species_leaf_bud_site <- st_as_sf(species_leaf_bud) %>% st_set_crs("EPSG:4326")

coordinates(species_color_leaf) <- c("Longitude", "Latitude")
species_color_leaf_site <- st_as_sf(species_color_leaf) %>% st_set_crs("EPSG:4326")

for (y in 2012:2016){
  ## insert alan
  raster_file <- str_c("~/phenology-urban/data/raw/CONUS/ALAN/VNP46A4_t",y,".tif")
  alan_year <- raster(raster_file)
  ## Remove very low values of NTL; can be considered noise
  alan_year[alan_year <= 2] <- 0
  ## Distribution is skewed, so log
  alan_year <- log(alan_year + 1)
  
  extract_alan <- extract(alan_year, species_leaf_bud_site)
  species_leaf_bud_site <- cbind(species_leaf_bud_site, setNames(list(extract_alan), paste0("alan_", y)))
}

for (y in 2012:2016){
  ## insert alan
  raster_file <- str_c("~/phenology-urban/data/raw/CONUS/ALAN/VNP46A4_t",y,".tif")
  alan_year <- raster(raster_file)
  ## Remove very low values of NTL; can be considered noise
  alan_year[alan_year <= 2] <- 0
  ## Distribution is skewed, so log
  alan_year <- log(alan_year + 1)
  
  extract_alan <- extract(alan_year, species_color_leaf_site)
  species_color_leaf_site <- cbind(species_color_leaf_site, setNames(list(extract_alan), paste0("alan_", y)))
}

saveRDS(species_leaf_bud_site, "result/npn_meng/leaf_bud.rds")
saveRDS(species_color_leaf_site, "result/npn_meng/color_leaf.rds")
```

processing
```{r}
species_leaf_bud <- readRDS("result/npn_meng/leaf_bud.rds")
species_color_leaf <- readRDS("result/npn_meng/color_leaf.rds")
 
species_leaf_bud <- species_leaf_bud %>%
  mutate(alan = case_when(
    First_Yes_Year == 2011 ~ alan_2012,
    First_Yes_Year == 2012 ~ alan_2012,
    First_Yes_Year == 2013 ~ alan_2013,
    First_Yes_Year == 2014 ~ alan_2014,
    First_Yes_Year == 2015 ~ alan_2015,
    First_Yes_Year == 2016 ~ alan_2016,
    TRUE ~ NA_real_ 
  )) %>% na.omit()

species_color_leaf <- species_color_leaf %>%
  mutate(alan = case_when(
    First_Yes_Year == 2011 ~ alan_2012,
    First_Yes_Year == 2012 ~ alan_2012,
    First_Yes_Year == 2013 ~ alan_2013,
    First_Yes_Year == 2014 ~ alan_2014,
    First_Yes_Year == 2015 ~ alan_2015,
    First_Yes_Year == 2016 ~ alan_2016,
    TRUE ~ NA_real_ 
  )) %>% na.omit()

# with ALAN: threshold at 75% with all sites from the papper (19.1 nW/cm2/sr)
# vagueness about the range
threshold <- log(19.1 +1)

analyze_leaf_bud <- filter(species_leaf_bud, alan >= threshold | alan == 0) %>%
  mutate(group = case_when(
    alan >= threshold ~ "ALAN",
    alan == 0 ~ "No ALAN"
    )) %>%
  mutate(Tavg_Winter = (Tmin_Winter + Tmax_Winter) / 2) %>% 
  mutate(Tavg_Spring = (Tmin_Spring + Tmax_Spring) / 2) %>% 
  mutate(Tavg_Summer = (Tmin_Summer + Tmax_Summer) / 2) %>% 
  mutate(Tavg_Fall = (Tmin_Fall + Tmax_Fall) / 2) 

analyze_color_leaf <- filter(species_color_leaf, alan >= threshold | alan == 0) %>%
  mutate(group = case_when(
    alan >= threshold ~ "ALAN",
    alan == 0 ~ "No ALAN"
    )) %>%
  mutate(Tavg_Winter = (Tmin_Winter + Tmax_Winter) / 2) %>% 
  mutate(Tavg_Spring = (Tmin_Spring + Tmax_Spring) / 2) %>% 
  mutate(Tavg_Summer = (Tmin_Summer + Tmax_Summer) / 2) %>% 
  mutate(Tavg_Fall = (Tmin_Fall + Tmax_Fall) / 2)
```

visualize Fig.2 - Bud break
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpmisc)

bins_bud <- seq(floor(min(analyze_leaf_bud$Tavg_Spring)), ceiling(max(analyze_leaf_bud$Tavg_Spring)), by = 1) 
# bins_color <- seq(floor(min(analyze_color_leaf$Tavg_Summer)), ceiling(max(analyze_color_leaf$Tavg_Summer)), by = 1)
# analyze_color_leaf_bin <- analyze_color_leaf %>% mutate(summer_bin = cut(analyze_color_leaf$Tavg_Summer, breaks = bins_color))

analyze_leaf_bud_bin <- analyze_leaf_bud %>% mutate(spring_bin = cut(analyze_leaf_bud$Tavg_Spring, breaks = bins_bud)) %>%
  filter(spring_bin != "(21,22]")%>%
  group_by(spring_bin, group) %>%
  summarise(
    mean = mean(First_Yes_DOY, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd = sd(First_Yes_DOY, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n(),
    se = sd / sqrt(n),
    ci = qt(0.975, df = n-1) * se
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

plot_bin <- ggplot(analyze_leaf_bud_bin, aes(x = spring_bin, y = mean, color = group)) +
  geom_point(position = position_dodge(0.2), size = 3) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean - ci, ymax = mean + ci), width = 0.2, position = position_dodge(0.2)) +
  geom_line(aes(group = group), position = position_dodge(0.2)) +
  labs(color = "Group") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("red", "blue")) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  ggtitle(str_c("Spring Temperature - Bud Break"))

plot_bin
ggsave("~/phenology-urban/result/npn_meng/Fig2_bud.jpg", plot_bin, width = 8, height = 6, units = "in")
```

model Table1 Fig3
```{r}
library(lme4)

mod <- lmer(First_Yes_DOY ~ Tavg_Spring + alan + Tavg_Spring*alan +(1 | Species) + (1 | First_Yes_Year), data = analyze_leaf_bud)
summary(mod)

mod2 <- lmer(First_Yes_DOY ~ Tavg_Summer + alan + Tavg_Summer*alan +(1 | Species) + (1 | First_Yes_Year), data = analyze_color_leaf)
summary(mod2)

# just the line for bud break model

# Step 1: Calculate the quantiles of temperature
quantiles <- quantile(analyze_leaf_bud$Tavg_Spring, probs = c(0.25, 0.5, 0.75))
# Step 2: Create a prediction dataset
log_alan_seq <- seq(min((analyze_leaf_bud$alan)), max((analyze_leaf_bud$alan)), length.out = 100)
prediction_data <- expand.grid(
  Tavg_Spring = quantiles,
  alan = log_alan_seq
)
# Step 3: Generate predictions and confidence intervals
# Assuming 'mod' is your mixed-effects model from lmer
prediction_data$prediction <- predict(mod, newdata = prediction_data, re.form = NA)

# Get the confidence intervals
ci <- predict(mod, newdata = prediction_data, re.form = NA, se.fit = TRUE)
prediction_data$ci_upper <- prediction_data$prediction + 1.96 * ci$se.fit
prediction_data$ci_lower <- prediction_data$prediction - 1.96 * ci$se.fit

# Step 4: Plot the predictions
ggplot(prediction_data, aes(x = alan, y = prediction, color = as.factor(Tavg_Spring))) +
  geom_line(aes(color = as.factor(Tavg_Spring))) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = ci_lower, ymax = ci_upper, fill = as.factor(Tavg_Spring)), alpha = 0.2) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("blue", "grey", "red")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("blue", "grey", "red")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "Log(ALAN)", y = "Phenology (DOY)", color = "Temperature Quantile", fill = "Temperature Quantile")
```

```{r}
# bud 
plot_sca <- ggplot(analyze_leaf_bud, aes(x = Tavg_Spring, y = First_Yes_DOY, color = group)) +    # city
    geom_point(alpha = 0.2,  stroke = NA) + 
    theme_classic() +
    labs(x = "Temp", y = "DOY") +  #city             
    theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 20), axis.title = element_text(size = 22)) +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = pretty(analyze_leaf_bud$Tavg_Spring)) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = pretty(analyze_leaf_bud$First_Yes_DOY)) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 0.5, hjust = 1),
      axis.title.x = element_text(margin = margin(t = 10)),
      axis.title.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = 10)),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 22),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 18)
    ) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, aes(group = group), formula = y ~ x) +  #city
    #geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "black", linetype = "dashed", formula = y ~ x) +
    stat_poly_eq(aes(label = paste(..eq.label.., ..rr.label.., ..p.value.label.., sep = "~~~~")),
                 formula = y ~ x,
                 parse = TRUE,
                 label.x = "right", label.y = "top",  
                 size = 2,
                 geom = "text",   
                 hjust = 1,       
                 vjust = -0.5     
    ) +
    
    ggtitle("Spring temp - bud break") +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 22))
```
